intent.instructions: Using the user's request and supplied EME project state, select exactly one canonical subsystem for the next action. Choose needs_planning when the request requires multiple dependent stages, cross-subsystem coordination, unresolved prerequisites, conflicting requirements, or clarification. Choose the narrowest appropriate route only when its scope is clear. Do not infer that any operation has already succeeded.

criteria.transcription: Speech recognition, transcript creation, or speaker identification.
criteria.subtitle_generation: Caption generation, subtitle styling, or word-level subtitle timing.
criteria.audio_cleanup: Noise reduction, equalization, loudness normalization, or audio ducking.
criteria.clip_selection: Highlight discovery, B-roll selection, or rough-cut candidate selection.
criteria.motion_graphics: Animated titles, lower thirds, callouts, or motion-graphic generation.
criteria.color_grading: Selection or adjustment of color grade and approved LUT looks.
criteria.timeline_manipulation: Explicit timeline operations such as split, trim, slip, slide, or ripple edit.
criteria.render_export: Final render, export, or format conversion when required upstream work is resolved.
criteria.media_qa: Inspection of supplied media-QA results or a request to validate media integrity.
criteria.needs_planning: Ambiguous, unsupported, conflicting, or multi-stage work requiring deliberate planning.

requires_multistep_plan.instructions: Does this request, given the supplied EME project state, require two or more dependent editing stages, unresolved prerequisites, or coordination across subsystems before a safe execution plan can be formed?

labels.false: No; the next action is sufficiently well-defined.
labels.true: Yes; deliberate multi-step planning is required.
